question.prompt: Kate bakes a \(20\)-inch by \(18\)-inch pan of cornbread. The cornbread is cut into pieces that measure \(2\) inches by \(2\) inches. How many pieces of cornbread does the pan contain?

solutions.title: Count rows and columns
solutions.explanation:
Think of the pieces as a grid of \(2\)-inch squares. Each row along the \(20\)-inch side contains \(20\div2=10\) pieces, and the \(18\)-inch width gives \(18\div2=9\) rows.

Thus the pan contains
\[
9\cdot10=\boxed{90}
\]
pieces, choice \(\text{(A)}\).
